players.product: DDR5 (up to 8000Mbps), LPDDR4X, LPDDR5/5X and LPDDR6 DRAM chips, DDR5 RDIMM / MRDIMM / UDIMM / SODIMM and LPCAMM modules, and DRAM wafers

quarterly_data.signal: CXMT's board approved (subject to shareholder approval) two new projects: a technology R&D project inside its Hefei 12-inch DRAM fab site (30-month build, mostly equipment purchases) and phase II of its Hefei memory wafer back-end test base, a test plant for DRAM chip testing and module assembly (37-month build). The company says test capacity must not become a bottleneck as its output and product range grow, outside OSATs may lack test capacity, and in-house testing lowers DRAM test cost and completes its IDM model.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D project total investment RMB 241.00 hundred-million (equipment RMB 223.98 hundred-million), 30 months; back-end test base phase II total investment RMB 108.00 hundred-million (equipment purchase and installation RMB 81.80 hundred-million), 37 months
